data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出免训练外部记忆框架：比较同一任务的多次尝试、诊断不足，合并并修订可复用经验，形成跨任务持久的记忆机制。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply.
scope_support.object_quote: Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay
scope_support.persistence_quote: This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson as a separate entry.
